positions.question: Do you generally support pro-choice or pro-life legislation?

evidence.text: "I do not support a national abortion ban – period. Don’t believe the lies you will hear. What I am wholeheartedly against are abortions in the third trimester only. Surveys show 80% of Americans agree with me on this stance."

"I stand with women on this issue and will fight to ensure that all women have access to the treatment and care they need and deserve. I also stand with the 80% of Americans who oppose abortions in the final three months outside of cases of rape, incest, and the clearly defined health of the mother. This is common sense."

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "I stand with women on this issue and will fight to ensure that all women have access to the treatment and care they need and deserve. I also stand with the 80% of Americans who oppose abortions in the final three months outside of cases of rape, incest, and the clearly defined health of the mother. This is common sense."

"As a New York State Assemblyman, I did not vote to codify Roe v. Wade into state law because it allowed provisions for the use of late-term abortions in the final three months of a pregnancy and language used in the bill pertaining to the "health" of the mother was vague and undefined."

positions.question: Do you support increasing security along the southern US border?

evidence.text: "In Congress, I will support H.R. 2 – a plan that keeps American safe. I will work to expand and modernize legal pathways for merit-based immigration so the best and brightest can pursue their own American Dream, and demand that only true asylum cases are heard on the spot, not seven years later. We will have physical barriers at all critical points along the border, fully fund biometric systems, and have tighter controls and oversight on our visa process."

"We will immediately seal the southern border to all illegal immigration. Period. If you want to start a new life in this country and become a productive member of society then you need to get in line and follow the rules – just like everyone else."

"When they called to abolish ICE a few years ago, I joined them for a ride-along right here on Long Island to see how the rid our communities of dangerous and violent criminals. In just the one night that I witnessed, they tracked down and apprehended multiple people who were in this country illegally and wanted for serious violent and heinous crimes in their home countries. This is the work ICE does. These Agents keep America safe. I fully support them in their efforts."
